online-shopping-discount v1.0.0

- Initial release: enables users to find discounted products, compare prices, generate promo links, and receive smart shopping suggestions for Taobao and JD.
- Supports product search by keywords, platform preference, and price range filtering.
- Guides user interaction: requests platform preference, shows detailed product info and recommendations, and only generates purchase links after user confirmation.
- Emphasizes security (credential protection) and compliance with platform rules.
